text: In this experiment, you will investigate the equilibrium position of a suspended cardboard sheet.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
• Set the compasses to a radius of approximately 9 cm and then use them to draw a circle
on the sheet of paper.
• Mark the centre of the circle with a cross.
• Measure and record the diameter D of the circle.
D = ______ cm

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
You are provided with a pendulum bob with a length of string attached.
• Tie a knot in the string approximately 19 cm from the top of the bob.
• Measure and record the distance p from the knot to the centre of the bob.
p = ______ cm
